verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships its own agents (the editor agent, the docs-writing agent and automations), so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Mintlify acting as an MCP server for outside tools: the search MCP, the admin MCP and the Index MCP. Nothing shows its agent or assistant connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools.
